items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: I got some of my -- I was inspired and it was more gratifying for some of the things I did with Everett Lee and Dean Dixon... I played concerts with both of them.

ctx.x: The band put him out. I was one of them that helped push him out. Oh, he was a great little guy, though.

You know, this has been a wonderful 50, 60, 62 years, I guess, and all the experiences I've had and the fun. I got some of my -- I was inspired and it was more gratifying for some of the things I did with Everett Lee and Dean Dixon, two of our greatest black symphony conductors. I played concerts with both of them. And coming to Las Vegas -- I came here not to retire. I came here with a new idea that I was going to go on, and I intend to go on. I intend to open up the situation here and I think it needs it. And I…
Vegas, so I hope I'm successful.
